Driven by Vision.
Defined by Quality.

LANDMARK is a full-service real estate company dedicated to elevating communities and bringing transformative developments to life.

Always on the cutting edge of modern construction, LANDMARK builds communities that transform neighborhoods. The name behind some of the most exciting developments of the last decade provides stellar service from planning to property management, as evidenced in their signature residential brand, CENTURION.

Offering life in the center of it all, CENTURION captures the strong, sustainable spirit of the LANDMARK development portfolio with a commanding presence in each community entered.

Real Estate with a Human Focus Approach

Strategic Planning. Our full-service, vertically integrated operations take properties from identification to stabilization with an owner’s standard of care.

In House Expertise. Landmark provides a full range of real estate services shaped by experience and a hands-on approach. We bring a deep understanding of what it takes to deliver thoughtful, lasting projects.

Capabilities

Investment

We identify opportunity where others see complexity — moving quickly in supply-constrained markets with the in-house expertise to evaluate, structure, and close.

Development

From entitlements to delivery, we lead every project hands-on — navigating complex approvals and building communities that set a new standard for their markets.

Construction

A senior construction executive on every project. Full-time, on-site oversight from predevelopment through turnover. No gaps in accountability, ever.

Management

We manage every asset we build. Through American Landmark Management LLC, we remain accountable for resident experience and long-term performance — long after construction closes.

The CENTURION Brand

CENTURION is LANDMARK’s signature residential brand — a growing collection of design-forward communities built in New Jersey’s most sought-after transit neighborhoods. Each property is shaped by its location and backed by LANDMARK’s full in-house platform: thoughtfully designed, expertly built, and managed with an owner’s accountability. CENTURION sets a new bar for what renters can expect from a neighborhood and a home.

LANDMARK. is a full-service real estate company based in Union, New Jersey. Founded by Manny A. Fernandez, the company is focused on the acquisition, development, construction and management of residential, mixed-use, and commercial properties in markets where opportunity and community need align. Since its founding, LANDMARK has built a reputation for unlocking value in complex, transitional markets — delivering communities that transform neighborhoods, activate street-level retail, and raise the standard for living and working across the region.

Redevelopment Case Study

CENTURION Union Center, Union, NJ

A six-phase, mixed-use redevelopment in the heart of downtown Union — 460 residential units and 15,000 square feet of retail space delivered through a public-private initiative with Union Township. CENTURION Union Center has transformed an underutilized corridor into a thriving, pedestrian-friendly community hub and stands as LANDMARK’s most ambitious and enduring proof of platform.

CENTURION Sleepy Hollow, Plainfield, NJ

A 100-unit luxury residential community developed through a public-private initiative, delivering design-forward rental living and ground-floor retail to a transit-connected neighborhood ready for reinvestment.

CENTURION Ironbound, Newark, NJ

A 72-unit, historically inspired residential community in Newark’s vibrant Ironbound district — design-forward rental living that draws on the neighborhood’s rich character while delivering modern amenities and a new standard of quality to one of New Jersey’s most dynamic urban neighborhoods.
